bottleneck.description: Broad factory automation portfolio (PLC, sensors, switches, vision); peer-competitive vs Siemens, Rockwell, Mitsubishi, Keyence.

dependency.key_customers: Global discrete-manufacturing factories across automotive, electronics, packaging

editorial.notes: Omron is a competent mid-tier FA vendor (~5-7% in its sub-segments) but faces a strong oligopoly above it (Siemens >20% PLC share, Rockwell 19% in NA, Mitsubishi, Schneider) and below it in sensors from Keyence. Switching from Omron to a competitor is operationally feasible within a project cycle. No bottleneck position.
